neighbours.label: The predicate of a sentence that defines something or says what role it plays ('is a garment worn to', 'is the starting point for', 'marked the end of'); plain descriptive sentences on the same subjects stay quiet.
fire: A tourniquet is a device used to stop bleeding.
A biopsy is a medical procedure performed to sample tissue.
This station is the starting point for most bus tours.
The treaty marked the end of the long war.
The film is the third part of a popular series.
Geneva serves as the focal point of Swiss banking.
A kilt is a skirt worn by men in Scotland.
A sonnet is a poem written in fourteen lines.
quiet: A tourniquet was lying on the floor of the van.
The doctor drove to the clinic after lunch.
This station is closed on Sundays.
The treaty was signed in the rain.
The film is long and my kids liked it.
Geneva has a lot of banks and shops.
A kilt was hanging in the hall.
A sonnet came in the mail today.

notes: Probes: 0.59-0.96 against 0.03-0.04. The peak token varies (' worn', ' point', ' of'), so this is a sentence type rather than a word.
